description: Kasteel Groeneveld at Baarn is an 18th-century brick country house, not a moated medieval castle. The main block and two curved wings share one dark pantile roof, with a stone stair up to the door and a balcony over it. It is overcast, about 11.9°C, with wind near 2.2 km/h and cloud cover about 100%. The house is closed. The coat of arms and the figures on the pediment are not readable. Late September, no flower display.
